summaryZh: Gur-Cohen Lab 研究上皮干细胞如何与微环境沟通，以维持干性并协调组织再生。研究结合细胞生物学、显微、小鼠遗传学及生物物理方法，探索环境信号如何引导干细胞活动。
researchQuestions: 上皮干细胞如何与支持它们的微环境沟通？
环境信号如何被解读并引导干细胞行为？

evidence.quote: Research efforts in the Gur-Cohen’s lab focus on mechanisms of how epithelial stem cells are communicating with their supporting microenvironment
We apply core techniques in cell biology, microscopy, mouse genetics and biophysics
elucidating how environmental cues are interpreted to guide stem cell behavior.
